title: Marketing sessions reader and warmer must share precompute_window_start
answers: Last 90 days marketing attribution falls back to live calculation despite backfill
Why is attribution session cache not used for relative date range
Where is the precompute coverage boundary defined for marketing sessions
body:
The cache coverage boundary is one function: `precompute_window_start(team, end)` in products/marketing_analytics/backend/hogql_queries/marketing_sessions_precompute.py.
- Writer/warmer: `ensure_marketing_sessions_precompute_op` in products/marketing_analytics/dags/marketing_sessions_precompute.py uses it as `start`.
- Reader: `ineligible_reason` in products/marketing_analytics/backend/hogql_queries/attribution_sessions_read.py returns `window_over_max` if `read.start - SESSION_READ_REACHBACK_DAYS < precompute_window_start(team, read.end)`.
- Boundary = local midnight (team.timezone_info) PRECOMPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS before end, converted to UTC, minus attribution_window_days + SESSION_READ_REACHBACK_DAYS as elapsed UTC days.
- If reader and warmer use different boundaries (e.g. elapsed seconds vs calendar day), full relative ranges like -90d wrongly become ineligible. Change both together.
applies: Marketing analytics attribution session precompute reader/warmer eligibility
